title: The floor's endless chains: the identification with chains, and the dimension
claim: With the floor allowed (RING-PAIR's S1, S2 dropped) and the candidate complex extended by each live knot's s = open - d pendant points and R(open) rays at each (0, 1, 2 for open >= 3, 2, 1), under (S3), (S4) and (S5+) every component holding a live knot is infinite: round t's junctions are the deck orbits of clusters of t + 1 points of the extended cover, parents the removable points, loose distinctions the boundary points; chain clusters (one removable point) are the offshoots (Theorem 1). For K a tree, c(t) is eventually a polynomial of degree R - 1, R the largest number of rays in one component, leading coefficient sum N_Y/(R-1)! (Theorem 2); in a bare tree rays come from leaves whose neighbour has degree 2 (Corollary 3).
standard_statement: As RING-IDENT's (site animals on tree-like covers, hyperbolic tree automorphisms, block graphs, reverse search); compositions of integers.
prior_work: RING-IDENT-20261119-001 (the identification without the floor), CLUSTER-ALL-20261119-001 (the chain rule and the dimension reading, computed), RING-PAIR-20261119-001.
completion_gate: The machine check (81 of 81 in-class starts agree; 137 relay starts differ); the referee reviews the proof.
